svg.title: Teach a task once, rerun the saved script later
svg.desc: 1: the first run opens news.ycombinator.com in a new browser, then writes and tests scripts/extract_top_stories.py and scripts/README.md in a workspace, with proof/run-1.json and proof/run-2.json. 2: a later run passes workspace_id: a new conversation and a new browser with the same saved files. 3: every run executes the script, which sends a fresh request to the live page and prints JSON with fetched_at, source_sha256 and five stories. fetched_at changes every run; source_sha256 changes only when the page does. 4: if the script fails or the output is malformed, the run inspects the live page and repairs the saved script.
